name: fscan-local-plugin-resource-leasing
instr:
fscan cannot inspect local plugin resource use before effects begin or prevent concurrent scans from contending for operating-system resources. Add planning and arbitration to core execution and embedded scanners without changing uncontended plugin behavior.

Every registered local `Plugin`, including cleaner, cron-task, forward-shell, SOCKS5, keylogger, LD preload, SSH key, and reverse-shell, must return a deterministic, effect-free plan through `plugins.Get(name)` from `github.com/shadow1ng/fscan/plugins`. Base it on effective defaults, configuration, platform state, and discovered users. Normalize equivalent filesystem paths and network addresses while preserving path-family boundaries and listener, outbound, device, store, shared, and exclusive semantics.

Acquisition must atomically lease a complete compatible plan. Rejection reports every conflict without retaining partial ownership. Immediate and waiting acquisition preserve existing leases. Cancellation returns the context error and prevents later grants.

Core execution must acquire before `Scan`, prevent conflicting effects, and release only when the actual scan terminates, including failure or cancellation. Cleaner, cron-task, keylogger, LD preload, and SSH-key plans must expose exactly what execution affects without deleting, creating, scheduling, configuring, or generating anything. Server leases cover their blocking lifetime; reverse-shell endpoints remain shared outbound access. Embedded planning and snapshots
